hypothesis: Layering the surviving SOL TabM-flat entry candidate (VAL +0.65% / OOS +4.08%, frozen rule side_prob_055) with (A) per-side TP-first quality gates and (B) a trailing-stop exit improves seed-mean fresh-forward PnL over the frozen baseline, on the grounds that (A) mirrors the h48qual quality-layer convention that works on ETH live, and (B) trailing stops are the one exit lever with a positive prior specifically on SHORT-HOLD triple-barrier ledgers (project-trailing-stop memory: the original G1 result stands for short-hold TB ledgers; the 2026-08-07 failures were on long-hold parents).

research.prior_failure_reassessment: Quality/threshold layers were the failure point on BTC zig075 and exit-logic tuning failed 23+ times on ETH Omega4.6.1 -- but every one of those exit failures was on long-hold models where reactive exits cut multi-day winners, and the BTC quality-layer failures were on retrospective zigzag labels. This SOL stack holds <=24h against the corrected causal TB label, the ledger type where trailing originally passed G1, and the quality heads are trained on the same causal TB per-side outcomes, not zigzag waves.
research.retest_design: Entry model, entry threshold (0.55) and all 5 seeds stay FROZEN from the parent survey. Layer A: two binary LightGBM heads (long/short TP-first, targets soft_long>soft_cash and soft_short>soft_cash) trained on purged train; gate grid q in {0.40,0.45,0.50,0.55} plus q=0 baseline-reproduction control, selected on seed-mean VAL PnL with >=15 seed-mean trades; adopted only if it beats the frozen baseline VAL (+0.65%). Layer B: trailing stop on top of the frozen layer-A choice; grid activation in {0.5,0.75} x trail-distance in {0.5,1.0} (of tp_move/sl_move respectively), close-based activation and ratchet, intrabar exit priority SL -> trail -> TP; adopted only if it beats the layer-A VAL. Exactly ONE OOS read of the final adopted stack; if neither layer beats baseline VAL, no new OOS read and the layering axis closes.

model.candidate_architecture: frozen 5-seed TabM-flat entry + LightGBM per-side TP-first quality gates (layer A) + close-ratchet trailing-stop exit (layer B)

selection.validation_pass_criteria: layer A adopted only if best gated seed-mean VAL PnL > frozen baseline +0.65% with seed-mean trades >= 15; layer B adopted only if best trailing config beats the adopted layer-A VAL; single OOS read of the final adopted stack only
